item.text: {"formal_eligible":false,"events":[{"memory_id":"M01","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Kept the first document compact, with each behavioral rule stated mainly in one requirement and one scope entry.","rationale":"Directly applicable to spec and acceptance-criteria writing."},{"memory_id":"M02","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Drove repository grounding before clarification and reasoned, one-at-a-time recommendations about product scope, configuration topology, and fallback behavior.","rationale":"The run inspected current specs, configuration parsing, PA composition, and classifier model routing before asking material product questions."},{"memory_id":"M03","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The Gate 1 task did not simplify implementation workflows or define implementation autonomy."},{"memory_id":"M04","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"No implementation or testing workflow was specified."},{"memory_id":"M05","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The change did not involve a prototype or UI/UX design."},{"memory_id":"M06","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"No interaction model or visual hierarchy was selected."},{"memory_id":"M07","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"No architecture or design review was performed under the task envelope."},{"memory_id":"M08","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The spec introduced no preview, inspector, or UI summary."},{"memory_id":"M09","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Acceptance criteria were expressed as operator- and product-observable model-selection, startup, and unchanged-behavior outcomes, without prescribing classes, APIs, or internal call paths.","rationale":"This matched the long-lived behavioral-spec boundary and reinforced the selected Skill’s equivalent rule."},{"memory_id":"M10","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"This was a feature specification, not a runtime bug-fix verification task."},{"memory_id":"M11","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"Implementation completion, PR readiness, and CI were outside Gate 1."},{"memory_id":"M12","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The run neither cleaned tests nor defined test-quality gates."},{"memory_id":"M13","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The required premise—confirmed development-stage status with backward compatibility explicitly declined—was not established."},{"memory_id":"M14","state":"loaded","affected_behavior":"No independent behavioral decision was derived from it.","rationale":"Although package boundaries were relevant background, repository redlines and Owner replies supplied stronger task-specific scope; exact responsibility and field placement were deferred to design."},{"memory_id":"M15","state":"overridden","affected_behavior":"The completed spec says an explicitly selected approval model applies after Gateway restart, rather than defining next-run hot application in existing conversations.","rationale":"Repository evidence showed the PA LLM catalog is loaded through the Gateway’s local startup configuration, and the Owner asked to follow the existing configuration topology with minimal change."},{"memory_id":"M16","state":"used","affected_behavior":"The invalid-model scenario requires Gateway startup to fail with the specific cause that the approval model is unregistered, and forbids silent fallback.","rationale":"This sharpened the Owner’s invalid-configuration decision into a semantically explicit, actionable failure outcome."},{"memory_id":"M17","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"Timeout, liveness, and watchdog semantics were explicitly outside the model-selection change."},{"memory_id":"M18","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"No entity identity, routing identity, rename, avatar, mention, or picker behavior was involved."},{"memory_id":"M19","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The task did not change approval-card UI, tool-call timelines, or execution-state presentation."},{"memory_id":"M20","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The change did not concern system-prompt feature composition or prompt preview."},{"memory_id":"M21","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"No optional discovery root or filesystem resource discovery behavior was specified."},{"memory_id":"M22","state":"used","affected_behavior":"Kept the unit limited to Personal Assistant automatic approval classification and explicitly excluded Coding CLI, ordinary conversation models, permission rules, approval UI, per-Agent selection, and a second config file.","rationale":"This directly supported the Owner-mandated product boundary and prevented unrelated expansion."},{"memory_id":"M23","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"The deliverable was a single product change spec, not reusable workflow or cross-project guidance."},{"memory_id":"M24","state":"rejected","affected_behavior":"None.","rationale":"Gate 1 defined behavioral scenarios but did not select E2E coverage or an acceptance-test journey."}]}
